title: Independence and Partition of India
summary: British rule ended and India and Pakistan became independent at midnight on 14-15 August 1947. Partition displaced 12 to 20 million people along religious lines; estimates of deaths in the violence range from 200,000 to two million.
why: Created two new nations at the cost of mass displacement and killing.

notes.problem: Gave displacement but no deaths; source gives 200,000 to two million (estimates as of 2009).
